label: Sync Gateway Application Read Only (Server RBAC role)
type: one of six fine-grained Server RBAC roles Couchbase Server 7.0.2 Developer Preview added specifically for Sync Gateway's Admin REST API. Read-only counterpart of role:sync-gateway-app: can read Sync Gateway users/roles and application data, cannot write either.
aliases_note: Same same-round self-fork shape as its siblings: A1 minted `role:sync-gateway-application-read-only`, A2 independently minted `role:sgw-application-read-only`. Filed under the internal name; both folded as aliases.
evidence: Role: Sync Gateway Application Read Only (sync_gateway_app_ro) ... Can read Sync Gateway users and roles ... Cannot add, drop, or edit users or roles.
note: Round 28 first contact with the 7.0.2+ fine-grained Sync-Gateway-RBAC catalogue extension, sibling of role:sync-gateway-app and role:sync-gateway-configurator.
